verdict: Two real failures on local Chrome (one test bug, one likely product bug) plus two page.goto timeouts in the same file that passed on retry; nothing points at the environment as a whole.

failures.test: Delivery estimate › the delivery date range is calculated from the visitor's date after load
failures.summary: The test fakes the clock to November 5, not October 5, because JS months are 0-indexed; the page correctly shows the November range.
failures.evidence: page.clock.setFixedTime(new Date(2026, 10, 5, 10)) with comment 'Monday 5 October'; snapshot 'definition: Nov 10-12' (Thu 5 Nov + 3–5 working days = Tue 10 to Thu 12 Nov).
failures.next_step: In delivery.spec.ts line 10, change to new Date(2026, 9, 5, 10) so the clock is Mon 5 Oct and 'Oct 08-12' is expected.

failures.test: Product info › sizes that are out of stock for the colour are disabled
failures.summary: After selecting Mustard, sizes S and XL are labelled out of stock but their radios stay enabled and selectable.
failures.evidence: Received: enabled (24× resolved to <input checked value="S" id="size-s" ...>); snapshot shows 'radio "S (out of stock)"' and 'radio "XL (out of stock)"' with no [disabled].
failures.next_step: Check the variant picker's colour-change handler: it should set the disabled property on size inputs with zero stock, not only update the label. Confirm with product owners that disabling is the intended behaviour.

failures.test: Product info › quantity cannot go above the stock of the selected variant
failures.summary: The beforeEach page.goto timed out waiting for the load event on the first attempt and passed on retry.
failures.evidence: TimeoutError: page.goto: Timeout 30000ms exceeded ... waiting until "load"; outcome flaky, attempts 2.
failures.next_step: Look for a slow or hanging subresource that delays 'load' on localhost:3100. If none is found, have gotoProduct wait for 'domcontentloaded' and then assert on the heading.

failures.test: Product info › Add to Cart updates the header basket badge
failures.summary: Same beforeEach goto load timeout, which passed on retry; the page had rendered but the load event never fired within 30s.
failures.evidence: TimeoutError: page.goto: Timeout 30000ms exceeded; the snapshot is fully rendered with 'definition: Calculating delivery date', and lastNavigation status is 200.
failures.next_step: Treat this together with the other goto timeout. Capture a trace or HAR on retry to find which request blocks 'load', which may be the delivery-date script.
